rawContent: Renewing my energy for Twitter as @gboladi pointed out that what is trending here is unacceptable in the context of anti-Black violence that happens daily, and the specific recent deaths and white supremacist response. #blacklivesmatter https://t.co/hmVEvLXyyR

If you are the kind of person who wants to read a book to learn, this book by @policingblack is the one. It talks about many of the institutions that have anti-Black and anti-Indigenous racism as their founding principle. I will order you your own copy! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/z3VK9Nnmb9

Are you the kind of person who likes to learn through podcasts? Try this one! ⁦@policingblack⁩ talks about one of the most recent deaths at the hands of police in Canada! We can listen together (apart) and discuss. #blacklivesmatter  https://t.co/Mp3SCFcpga

Are you a white person who has used the word #intersectionality - in a job interview, research paper, anti-o training? I am. We need to say #blacklivesmatter, lead our institutions to do better by, for, and with Black folks & donate somewhere that is Black-led (@AAPolicyForum).

Today's #BlackLivesMatter watching list is Kimberlé Crenshaw's TED Talk on #SayHerName: "So what do you call being impacted by multiple forces and then abandoned to fend for yourself? Intersectionality seemed to do it for me." @sandylocks https://t.co/pSDaWmDGdX
